q.line: The falling seed the wind carries
q.linePrev: Of waves crashing against the cliffs

q.line: Said, "It's too much shit to carry"
stanza: I asked you, "How is your sister?
I heard she got her degree"
And I said, "That makes me feel old"
You said, "What does that make me?"
I asked you, "How is playing drums?"
Said, "It's too much shit to carry"
